Record notes

Local MCP gateway and app guidance for seven separately installed ArtCraft apps.

Version 0.2.1 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Full original gateway and workflow; provider binaries excluded.

Requirements: Python >=3.10; ArtCraft CLI for provider operations.

License scope: MIT. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add artcraft-design-toolkit@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 334c118ac087eabf23c52a265632196818ddc5d3. SHA-256: 294f76722538bf078cc8de144408e24b6d52b395120aeb685941560713b0941d.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
